Slick, slime-drenched cobra with an elderly man's head. Dwell in muck. 13 feet long.

AC 14, HP 25, ATK 2 bite +4 (1d8 + poison) and 1 spell +4, MV near (swim), S +3, D +3, C +3, I +2, W +3, Ch +3, AL C, LV 5

Command Ooze. Oozes and slimes hearing naga's commands, CHA 15+ or charmed for 1d8 days.

Fog (INT Spell). DC 12. For 1d4 rounds, fog fills a near-sized cube centered on naga. It spreads around corners. Creatures inside the cloud are blinded.

Lightning (INT Spell). DC 13. A 5-foot wide line of electricity extending far from naga, 3d6 damage.

Magic Bolt (INT Spell). DC 11. 1d4 damage to one target within far.

Poison. CON 15+ or paralyzed 1d4 rounds.
